How we know

Capital City Cyclists' ride calendar lists the Tuesday After Work Ride for Sept 29 and Oct 6, 13, 20 and 27, 2026 at 6:00 PM from Killearn United Methodist Church; the event page says no drop ride with re-groupings (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

Last seen happening Sep 29, 2026.

Hosted by
Capital City CyclistsClub
Kind of ride
Road · Social

For visitors

Helmet and group-ride experience expected, no earbuds. Rear light and headlight highly recommended, since the route goes around a roundabout several times. Non-members should check the club's registration and waiver rules on the event page.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Not posted. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tuesday After Work Ride (Killearn) group ride

Tuesday After Work Ride (Killearn) is a road and social group ride in Tallahassee, FL. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 pm from Killearn United Methodist Church.

Capital City Cyclists' weekday evening road ride out of Killearn. It is a no-drop ride that regroups, and the club suggests a happy hour afterward.
